source: 5.1 collection masters · PRiSM E01–07 · SiLVER70 E08–12
description: Buffy arrives in Sunnydale hoping to leave Slayer duty behind, but the Hellmouth beneath her new school quickly draws her, Giles, Willow and Xander into a fight against the Master and his vampires.

s01e01.description: Newly arrived Buffy tries to keep her supernatural calling secret at Sunnydale High, but a vampire attack and her meeting with Watcher Rupert Giles make normal life immediately impossible.

s01e02.description: Buffy and her new friends race to stop the Master’s followers from completing the Harvest, a ritual that could free him and open the Hellmouth beneath Sunnydale.

s01e03.description: A series of bizarre accidents around cheerleading tryouts leads Buffy to suspect witchcraft, while the real source of the spells proves closer to one competitor than expected.

s01e04.description: After Buffy’s biology teacher is killed, his alluring replacement begins targeting male students, and Buffy discovers she is dealing with a giant predatory creature disguised as a woman.

s01e05.description: Buffy tries to have an ordinary date with Owen just as Giles warns that a prophesied vampire warrior is about to rise, forcing romance and Slayer duty into direct conflict.

s01e06.description: A zoo visit leaves Xander and several classmates possessed by hyena spirits, turning them cruel and increasingly dangerous as Buffy and Willow try to reverse the transformation.

s01e07.description: Buffy learns that Angel is a vampire with a soul after their growing attraction collides with Darla’s attempt to turn them against each other.

s01e08.description: Willow’s online romance becomes dangerous when the mysterious boy is actually a demon released into the internet, giving an ancient evil access to modern technology and human followers.

s01e09.description: When students in the talent show are found with missing organs, Buffy suspects an unnerving ventriloquist’s dummy before discovering that the real killer is hunting something very specific.

s01e10.description: Sunnydale residents’ worst fears begin becoming real, forcing Buffy and her friends to confront living nightmares while they trace the phenomenon to a traumatized child.

s01e11.description: An invisible student begins attacking Cordelia and her friends, and Buffy discovers how years of being ignored can literally erase someone from everyone else’s perception.

s01e12.description: A prophecy says Buffy will die at the Master’s hands, forcing her to decide whether to face him anyway when the Hellmouth begins opening beneath Sunnydale.
